prompt: Trace the call chain that runs when a user invokes `loomgraph topology`. List loomgraph production functions in execution order, from the click command down to the analysis routine that returns the result. One function per line. Ignore stdlib (asyncio, click) and JSON output helpers.

ground_truth.notes:
Short, clean Class B chain (5 entities). Within-class control for B-1/B-2 which are longer.

Chain:
1. `topology` (click command, src/loomgraph/cli/_analysis.py)
2. `_async_topology` — the async helper, calls prepare_workspace_store, instantiates TopologyAnalyzer, calls .analyze()
3. `prepare_workspace_store` — workspace resolution + store instantiation
4. `create_graph_store` — called inside prepare_workspace_store
5. `TopologyAnalyzer.analyze` — runs the actual graph analytics (orphan / hub / god queries against store)

Verified empirically via `loomgraph graph topology --direction callees --depth 1` then walking _async_topology.

Note on `TopologyAnalyzer.analyze`: the graph may capture this as just `analyze` (unbound method); accept either name. Class A1 ABC-dispatch pattern doesn't apply here because TopologyAnalyzer isn't an ABC.

rationale: Class B call-chain tracing on a shorter chain than B-1/B-2 — within-class size control. Tests whether the differential between Path A and Path B is robust on short chains (where README description might be enough) vs long chains (where graph traversal is essential).
